name: github-banner-studio
description: Create and validate GitHub repository banners, logos, and coordinated brand assets with GitHub Banner Studio.

interface.longDescription: Analyze a user-specified GitHub or local repository read-only, then create editable README banners and repository logos. Includes dedicated Banner and Logo Skills plus a complete brand coordination workflow. Uses the Studio's local Bun rendering and validation tools. Run it from a Studio checkout with dependencies installed; outputs stay in the Studio and the source repository remains read-only.
capabilities: Read-only analysis of a user-specified GitHub or local repository
Create, export, and validate README banners
Create, export, and validate repository logos
Coordinate a consistent logo and banner workflow
defaultPrompt: Use $repository-banner to create a README banner for a specified repository
Use $repository-logo Create to create or refine a repository logo
Use $repository-brand to plan a complete logo and banner identity
